snippet.title: Astral Hunter: Homebound - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Hunt, Capture, and Evolve! Astral Hunter: Homebound Gameplay 🚀👽

Welcome to an alien planet where survival means turning your enemies into your strongest allies! In Astral Hunter: Homebound, we dive into a fast-paced top-down action roguelite where you don't just blast through alien hordes—you capture them. Bring the best specimens back to your base to build a ranch for idle resource farming, or summon their unique abilities right in the middle of chaotic bullet-hell combat!

In this video, we test out the launch version, mix and match weapon modules, and try to capture our first elite alien creatures across challenging stages. With 8 unique weapons, 120 modules, and over 120 items to absorb and transform your character, the build variety is insane!
